services.title: Bookkeeping
services.summary: Complete bookkeeping services for small businesses
services.text: Complete bookkeeping services for small businesses, prepared and presented for your review quarterly, monthly or annually.
services.lead: Timely, efficient bookkeeping services are available for businesses of all sizes. Computerized accounts are prepared, saved and presented for client review on a quarterly, monthly, and/or annual basis. Budgeting and forecasting support are also available. We support all major accounting programs including Quickbooks.

services.title: Financial Planning
services.summary: Planning for retirement, college and more
services.text: Full service financial planning for future goals, from retirement to a child's college education.
services.lead: Whether planning for retirement or for a child's college education, financial planning is the cornerstone for meeting your goal. We help individual and business clients with a full array of planning tools. Our planning also incorporates tax and estate planning.

services.title: Financial Statements
services.text: Monthly, quarterly and year-end balance sheets and operating statements, prepared accurately and on time.
services.lead: Financial Statement preparation for small business clients is a long-standing service of this firm. Depending on the client's needs, monthly, quarterly and year-end balance sheet and detailed operating statements can be prepared and analyzed on a timely basis. The state-of-the-art accounting software used in our office can provide helpful comparisons and calculations for effective, practical business analysis.

services.title: Individual Tax
services.summary: Federal and state returns for individuals
services.text: A core specialty: thousands of Federal and State returns for individual taxpayers have been prepared and filed over the years.
services.lead: A core specialty is the preparation of tax returns for individual taxpayers. Over the years literally 1000's of Federal and State returns have been prepared and filed.

services.title: Payroll Services
services.text: Total payroll services for small business clients, from time cards and withholdings to W-2s and 1099s.
services.lead: Total payroll services for small business clients have been provided for many years. Services include: Set up and maintenance of all records, time card tabulations, withholdings of tax and benefit contributions, Federal and State tax filings, issuance of checks and preparation of all W-2's and 1099 forms.

services.title: Business Tax Returns
services.summary: C Corp, S Corp, LLC and partnership returns
services.text: Small business tax returns for C corporations, S corps, LLCs, partnerships and sole proprietors, prepared to minimize the tax owed.
services.lead: Small business tax return preparation and filing instructions is a core service offered to our clients. Whether your company is a C corporation, S Corp, Limited Liability Company, Partnership or Sole Proprietor a properly prepared tax return can be filed to minimize the tax owed. Over the years, 100's of small business Federal and State tax returns have been prepared for both service and manufacturing company clients.

services.title: Tax Planning
services.text: Tax planning and forecasting for individual and small business clients, with long-term strategy and mid-year planning.
services.lead: Tax planning and tax forecasting services for individual and small business clients is a core competency of the firm. Effective tax minimization begins with long-term tax strategizing to establish overall objectives and is maintained with conscientious and consistent annual tax forecasting and mid-year tax planning.

about.title: About Rivera & Co. Tax & Business Services
text: Our company specializes in bookkeeping and tax preparation services for a wide variety of clients: business and personal tax return filing, bookkeeping and financial statements for small businesses, and corporate (LLC, Inc, S Corp, Partnership) tax return filing. Hablamos Español.

Annual participation in Continuing Professional Education courses offered by local chapters of national accounting and tax associations keeps our firm on the leading edge of ever-changing tax laws and accounting methods.
Computerized offices and internet access ensures clients accurate, efficient, state-of-the-art service at a competitive price. Feel free to contact the office anytime. We're here to help.
